subject: CI/CD seat consolidation + registry add-on pricing alignment
messages:
From: Sophie Green <sophie@buildkite.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick note on consolidating Buildkite seats / add-on alignment

Hi Marcus —

Thanks again for the time earlier. I pulled the usage numbers you asked for and wanted to start a short thread to surface a couple of items we can fold into the commercial:

- Seat consolidation: you mentioned moving 3 smaller teams into the central org to reduce seat overhead. We can offer a blended seat rate if you commit to a 12‑month term.
- Registry add-on overlap: I see you have the Harbor container registry add‑on for vulnerability scanning. When we align contract dates we can offer a cross‑product discount for combined billing.

If it helps, I can sketch a one‑page summary (costs + term) and send for legal review. I copied Dev so he has the usage numbers.

Best,
Sophie
Account Executive, Buildkite

Attachment: usage_report_q4_2026.csv (CSV summary of active agents, peaks, and seat churn)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Green <sophie@buildkite.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick note on consolidating Buildkite seats / add-on alignment

Thanks Sophie — good start. A few specifics from our side:

- Current seat split: 120 core CI seats (central), ~36 ephemeral seat licenses across three infra teams we want to fold in. Goal is to target a single invoice and a 12–18 month commitment.
- Registry alignment: Harbor's renewal lands on 2027-03-01 and Buildkite auto-renews on 2027-03-05 — we need both to be aligned to the same billing period. If Buildkite can add a 60‑day price lock that spans our Harbor renewal, that makes procurement easier.
- Legal: we have a Cust‑SaaS addendum that requires an indemnity tweak for third‑party scanning integrations; can you note that in the commercial?

Attaching the usage export and the last Harbor invoice for reference. Dev / Lauren — can you confirm whether we want 12 or 18 months? My preference is 12 with an option to convert to 18 later.

Thanks,
Marcus
SVP, Platform Engineering

Attachments: usage_report_q4_2026.csv; registry_invoice_dec2026.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Quick note on consolidating Buildkite seats / add-on alignment

Lauren — forwarding Sophie

Quick ask: procurement + legal will need to see a line‑item SOW and a price‑lock clause that explicitly covers the period 2027-03-01 through 2028-02-28. If we can get a 12‑month committed term at the blended rate Sophie referenced, we can move forward. Also need confirmation that Buildkite can invoice monthly but aggregate one invoice for both products (Buildkite + registry add‑on).

Can you route to legal and procurement and loop Connor at Atlas Apps if they need to approve the joint discount?

—Marcus

From: Sophie Green <sophie@buildkite.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: consolidated seats + registry add‑on (proposal attached)

Marcus / team —

Thanks for the details and the attachments. Attached is a short commercial summary and the proposed amendment (PDF). Highlights:

- Blended seat rate for 156 seats at $8.25/user/month with a 12‑month commitment. Annual expected saving vs current list: ~17%.
- Registry add‑on: 15% cross‑product discount if Buildkite invoices the Harbor add‑on as a line item on a single monthly invoice.
- Price lock: 60 days from signature; we will not increase unit pricing during that window.
- Legal redline: we added a limited indemnity clause for vendor‑recommended scanning connectors, flagged as Section 4.2 in the amendment.

DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/proposal-ATLAS-BK-2027

Attachment: BK_proposal_2027-02.pdf (commercial summary + amendment)

Let me know if procurement needs anything further to approve. Happy to hop on a 30‑minute call.

Best,
Sophie
Account Executive, Buildkite

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Green <sophie@buildkite.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Proposal: consolidated seats + registry add‑on (proposal attached)

Sophie —

Thanks for the clean summary. Procurement reviewed the commercial and legal sign‑off is good on the limited indemnity language. Two quick asks before we countersign:

1) Can you confirm Buildkite will delay any auto‑renewal triggers until 2027‑02‑28 so we can align the Harbor renewal and finalize the single invoice flow?
2) Please update the DocuSign envelope to reflect deal id ATLAS-BK-HARBOR-2027-Q1 and include the HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/78910 in the comments field for our finance team.

If you can confirm those, we will route for signature and process PO issuance.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
